name: Potong Pasir Fringe
summary: Edges of Potong Pasir toward Woodsville / McNair — NEL-adjacent mid-town living with quieter residential texture than Kallang Bend nightlife spill.
body: Potong Pasir Fringe is the shortlist when NEL adjacency and older estate texture matter more than CBD skyline views. The pocket sits on the Potong Pasir / Woodsville / McNair edges; housing mixes HDB blocks and selective mid-age condo stock. Expats land here for car-light hops to Novena / Bugis and lower weekend theatre than Lavender. Watch-outs: estate credential stacks that still want owner letters for fob replacement, evening bus bunching, and comparing ActiveSG fencing programmes across neighbouring centres. Compare with Kallang Bend for stadium-adjacent energy, Lavender North for EWL mid-town, and Bendemeer West when quieter NEL edges win.
